trust_decision.summary: An authenticated MCP client controls the last two path segments of a read_resource URI and the server performs no ownership check at all: the namespace segment (flow id or user id) is passed straight into the storage service, so any user can list every user's flows/files and read any flow's stored file. Decided by the absence of a user/project filter in handle_read_resource and handle_list_resources, plus storage services that compose data_dir/flow_id/file_name without any containment check on the read path.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names unscoped MCP resource handlers; the read handler is the sink where a client-supplied namespace and filename go straight to storage, so an engineer looks here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP read_resource on the global server (GET /api/v1/mcp/sse, /api/v1/mcp/streamable)
MCP list_resources on the global server (GET /api/v1/mcp/sse, /api/v1/mcp/streamable)
MCP list_tools on the global server (GET /api/v1/mcp/sse, /api/v1/mcp/streamable)
StorageService.save_file/get_file/get_file_stream/delete_file/get_file_size, reached from MCP read_resource and from /api/v1/files/* and /api/v2/files/*
lfx StorageService public API used by components via lfx.services.deps.get_storage_service (src/lfx/src/lfx/services/deps.py:84)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: lfx is a separate library package, and what the Langflow backend actually wires is langflow.services.storage.local via StorageServiceFactory (src/backend/base/langflow/services/storage/factory.py:18-22), so the reported MCP route is already fixed once that class is hardened.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: User-level files uploaded through /api/v2/files are stored under the owner's user id, not a flow id, and the global MCP server must keep listing and reading them (namespace segment may be a user id); a fix that requires the namespace to be a flow the caller owns breaks File Manager uploads. Project-scoped resource listing must also keep returning the project's own flow files.

O6_input_shapes: percent-encoded traversal in filename after urlparse split, e.g. ..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd
namespace segment is a flow UUID
namespace segment is the caller's own user UUID (user bucket)
project_id absent (global server) vs UUID/str (project server)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Storage path-builder primitives still compose data_dir/flow_id/file_name with no containment check after the fix; flow-saved file_path values and tool-mode file_path_str reach them via resolve_component_path/get_full_path and then a real file open (src/lfx/src/lfx/graph/vertex/param_handler.py:155-171, src/lfx/src/lfx/components/files_and_knowledge/file.py:603-619, src/lfx/src/lfx/custom/custom_component/custom_component.py:184-188)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: build_full_path/resolve_component_path are just path-string helpers, not reads; the values come from flow authors and component code rather than from an MCP client, so the storage containment check is argued not to belong there.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same lfx package, 2 files from the storage module; also present in the backend implementation (src/backend/base/langflow/services/storage/local.py:41-60), i.e. 2 packages from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A project/flow-scoped file-download route that passes a namespace taken from the stored File row (instead of str(current_user.id)) into get_file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file manager already stores paths with a namespace prefix and re-derives file_name from them, so a sibling that forwards the stored parent directory is a natural refactor and would reopen cross-namespace reads.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A project file-listing endpoint that queries Flow by folder_id without the owner filter, mirroring the list_resources bug the fix closes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This builder already issues project-scoped Flow queries and returns them to an MCP client; copying its query shape for a files endpoint is a one-line mistake.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Image/attachment loading that splits a stored path into (flow_id, file_name) and passes both straight to get_file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already calls parse_file_path on persisted state, so a crafted stored path (rename after the check) would select another namespace's directory.

O9_family: CWE-639 authorization bypass through user-controlled key (IDOR) combined with CWE-22 path traversal
